title: Student Assistant – Supply Chain Analytics
description_md:
In this role, you will support our Supply Chain organization through data-driven analysis, process improvement, and cross-functional collaboration.

Your responsibilities will include analyzing sales order behaviour, identifying critical purchasing items and supply risks, improving existing processes, and developing insights and reporting to support better decision-making across Supply Chain.
